# `candid tailor`

Tailored resume / cover letter.

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid tailor [-h] [--jd JD] [--app-id APP_ID] [--company COMPANY] [--role ROLE] [--tone {concise,confident,formal,warm}] [--length {one-page,detailed}] [--hook HOOK] [--out OUT] {resume,cover-letter}
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `what` | resume: tailored resume · cover-letter: tailored cover letter (required) |
| `--jd` `JD` | JD text, file path, URL, or - to read the JD from stdin (e.g. `cat jd.txt | python -m candid match --jd -`) |
| `--app-id` `APP_ID` | Tracked job id — pulls company/role/JD from the tracker |
| `--company` `COMPANY` | - |
| `--role` `ROLE` | - |
| `--tone` `TONE` | (default: confident) |
| `--length` `LENGTH` | (default: one-page) |
| `--hook` `HOOK` | One-line 'why this company' for cover letters |
| `--out` `OUT` | Write to file instead of stdout |
